lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct white vertical lines are visible from the shoulder to the posterior flank; spacing is narrowest in the mid-torso (approx. 3-4x line width) and wider at the anterior and posterior extremities.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first and second anterior lines terminate in the upper third of the torso; lines 10 and 11 exhibit fragmentation into discrete blobs before reaching the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 7 high-contrast spots is visible on the lower haunch and upper hind limb, concentrated primarily in the area posterior to the final continuous vertical line.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the mid-posterior haunch align horizontally, creating a geometric line segment approximately parallel to the dorsal-ventral axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a white chevron marking between the orbital regions, white patches on the lower mandible/cheek area, and a dark-colored dorsal crest extending from the neck to the tail base.
